label: Nothing that is being moved in a…, from Nothing is moved except insofar as it is in… and 2 more (2)
description: Per-sense argument, IN-ACT_2 (virtual act): both act premises read virtually give no self-motion in the same respect. The virtual mover premise avoids the counterexamples of causes that produce what they do not formally have; the virtual non-simultaneity premise carries the burden.
